description:
The NEW 2025 EVRYjourney 500w has the same frame geometry that has made this electric bike so incredibly popular, but now it comes with an ultra shock absorbing front fork. This fork will smoothly glide up and down as you roll over bumps on the terrain you're traversing. No more vibrations running through your body as you hit a bump or take on uneven ground. The suspension fork makes the ride soft on your body, making for a much more comfortable, relaxed ride. To cap it off the 2025 EVRYjourney features a front headlight controlled by the electrical systems controls located on the handlebars. Easily turn on the lights to light your way during night rides.

The EVRYjourney Electric features an ultra-comfortable, ergonomic frame designed to keep you in a naturally upright and relaxed position, minimizing strain on your back, hips, shoulders, and knees. If you haven’t ridden a bike in years, this e-bike is the ideal choice for getting back on the road with confidence. Its low step-through frame allows for effortless mounting and dismounting, while the forward pedaling design ensures optimal leg extension without sacrificing stability. Sitting closer to the ground enhances balance, makes stopping safer, and allows you to easily place both feet flat on the ground—reducing the risk of tipping and giving you total control at every stop.

The 500-watt electric bike motor offers three versatile riding modes to match your needs. Want a traditional cycling experience? Keep the motor off and rely entirely on your legs for power, just like a regular bike. Looking to ride farther without exhausting yourself? Engage pedal assist, which provides a boost only when you pedal—perfect for tackling long distances with ease. Prefer a completely effortless ride? Use the thumb throttle to let the motor take over, allowing you to sit back, relax, and soak in the scenery. Whether you're commuting a bit farther than usual, conquering steep hills, or simply looking to enjoy every ride with less effort, this e-bike ensures a smooth, enjoyable journey every time.

Ultra Smooth Suspension fork for shock absorption over bumps and uneven terrain

500 Watt Motor that functions either in pedal assist or full electric mode

Top speed of 20mph for both full electric and with pedal assist

500 Watt Hour Battery that will take you 20 miles using full electric and 20 - 40 miles on pedal assist mode

26-inch wheels with 1.95-inch semi-slick tires provide excellent roll and a cushioned, stable ride

Front and rear disc hand brakes for easy and prompt stopping

Incredibly bright front headlight for full street illumination when riding at night

Ultra comfortable ergonomic frame design keeps you in an upright, relaxed riding position reducing strain on your back, hip, shoulders and knees

Fits riders from 5 feet to 6 feet, 4 inches tall

Battery Compliant to the UL 2271 Standard as Tested by ACT Labs
